question_record.context: A security incident involving suspicious activities was detected on a machine `vnevado-win10s`, with observed unusual WMI process creation. Various suspicious commands and scripts were executed during this time. For instance, the command `vssblatemp.exe delete shadows /all` was executed, which may indicate malicious intent such as attempting to delete file snapshots and shadow copies via WMI or VSSAdmin. This is often seen during ransomware infections.
question_record.question: Related to this incident, can you provide the details of the process including the Process ID and the exact command line used for deleting snapshots and shadow copies?
solution: A suspicious WMI process creation was observed on the machine by the user with SID `S-1-5-21-1840191660-8534830288-125585561-1522`.
File backups were deleted via the command line `vssblatemp.exe delete shadows /all` by a process with ID `7236` on `2024-06-20t09:10:51.2193152z`.

144.name: Suspicious WMI process creation
144.description: Suspicious WMI process creation was observed on the machine. Malware frequently use WMI to spawn new processes, breaking process trees and further infecting a machine.

70.name: File backups were deleted
70.description:
All file snapshots and shadow copies have been deleted via WMI or VSSAdmin which is common during Ransomware infection.

For more information, read the Activity Profile: Iranian MOIS operators opportunistically deploy limited-impact wiper in response to Israel-Hamas war Threat Analytics report: https://security.microsoft.com/threatanalytics3/c6674205-df28-453a-9e42-0010b7979bdd/overview?tid4b2462a4-bbee-495a-a0e1-f23ae524cc9c
